executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd();REL='reports/research/510300_official_pmi_interpretation_cause_source_qualification_v1';OUT=ROOT/REL
receipts=json.loads((OUT/'原官方解读收件.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
proto=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert not (OUT/'全部三月官方正文与时钟候选.json').exists(),'原正文已提取，不重复。'
sources=[];md=[]
for item in receipts['receipts']:
 record={**item,'source_extraction_status':'PENDING'}
 if item.get('http_status')!=200:
  record['source_extraction_status']='UNKNOWN_NO_HTTP200_SOURCE';sources.append(record);continue
 data=(ROOT/item['raw_path']).read_bytes()
 assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==item['sha256']
 soup=BeautifulSoup(data,'html.parser')
 metas=[]
 for m in soup.find_all('meta'):
  name=m.get('name',m.get('property',''));value=m.get('content','')
  if any(w in name.lower() for w in ['title','pub','date','source','modified','created']):
   metas.append({'name':name,'content':value})
 nodes=soup.select('.TRS_Editor')
 scope='TRS_Editor'
 if not nodes:nodes=soup.select('.trs_editor_view');scope='trs_editor_view'
 if not nodes:nodes=soup.select('#zoom,#Zoom');scope='Zoom'
 assert nodes,('未定位原官方正文',item['stat_month'])
 body=max(nodes,key=lambda n:len(n.get_text(' ',strip=True)))
 ps=body.find_all(['p','h1','h2','h3','h4'])
 original=[n.get_text(' ',strip=True) for n in ps]
 original=[t for t in original if t]
 if not original:original=[body.get_text(' ',strip=True)]
 leaves=[];aggregates=[]
 for i,t in enumerate(original):
  contained=[j for j,u in enumerate(original) if j!=i and len(u)>15 and u in t]
  if len(t)>1000 and len(contained)>=5:
   aggregates.append({'paragraph_index':i,'contained_leaf_count':len(contained)})
  else:leaves.append({'paragraph_index':i,'text':t})
 assert leaves
 title_values=[m['content'] for m in metas if 'title' in m['name'].lower()]
 h_titles=[h.get_text(' ',strip=True) for h in soup.find_all(['h1','h2'])]
 identity_titles=[t for t in title_values+h_titles if '赵庆河' in t and '2024年' in t and '采购经理指数' in t]
 assert identity_titles and any(f"{int(item['stat_month'][-2:])}月" in t for t in identity_titles),(item['stat_month'],identity_titles)
 date_leaf=[]
 for n in soup.find_all(['span','p','td','div']):
  if n.find(['span','p','td','div']):continue
  txt=n.get_text(' ',strip=True)
  if len(txt)<90 and re.search(r'2024(?:[-/年])\d{1,2}(?:[-/月])\d{1,2}',txt):
   date_leaf.append(txt)
 manufacture=[];started=False
 for p in leaves:
  t=p['text']
  if re.search(r'一[、.]',t) and '制造业' in t:started=True
  if started and re.search(r'二[、.]',t) and '非制造业' in t:break
  if started:manufacture.append(p)
 assert manufacture,('制造业解读章节未识别',item['stat_month'])
 purchase_theme=[];cause_candidates=[];independent_survey_candidates=[]
 for p in manufacture:
  clean=p['text'].replace('中国物流与采购联合会','发布者').replace('制造业采购经理指数','制造业PMI').replace('采购经理指数','PMI')
  if any(w in clean for w in ['采购','备料','备货','购入','囤货']):purchase_theme.append(p)
  if any(w in clean for w in ['受','由于','带动','春节','反映','调查','需求不足','订单不足','成本','返乡','复工']):
   cause_candidates.append(p)
  if any(w in clean for w in ['调查','反映']) and any(w in clean for w in ['企业','比重','占比','不足']):
   independent_survey_candidates.append(p)
 record.update({'source_extraction_status':'ORIGINAL_BODY_AND_TITLE_BOUND',
  'official_identity_titles':identity_titles,'publication_metadata':metas,'publication_leaf_candidates':list(dict.fromkeys(date_leaf)),
  'url_archive_date':re.findall(r't(20\d{6})_',item['url']),
  'body_scope':scope,'all_original_paragraphs':original,'aggregated_parent_records':aggregates,
  'leaf_paragraphs':leaves,'manufacturing_paragraphs':manufacture,
  'purchase_behavior_theme':purchase_theme,'cause_context_candidates':cause_candidates,
  'independent_survey_candidates':independent_survey_candidates,'manual_information_qualification':'PENDING',
  'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False})
 sources.append(record)
 md.extend(['# '+item['stat_month']+' 官方解读（原文核对）','',
            '来源：'+item['url'],'',
            '页面元信息：'+json.dumps(metas,ensure_ascii=False),'',
            '页面显示日期候选：'+json.dumps(record['publication_leaf_candidates'],ensure_ascii=False),''])
 for p in manufacture:md.extend([f"段落{p['paragraph_index']}：{p['text']}",''])
(OUT/'全部三月官方正文与时钟候选.json').write_text(json.dumps(sources,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
(OUT/'全部三月制造业解读_逐段原文.md').write_text('\n'.join(md),encoding='utf-8')
for r in sources:
 print('\n统计月',r['stat_month'],'状态',r['source_extraction_status'])
 print('日期元信息',json.dumps(r.get('publication_metadata',[]),ensure_ascii=False))
 print('显示日期',r.get('publication_leaf_candidates'))
 print('采购主题数',len(r.get('purchase_behavior_theme',[])),'独立调查主题候选',len(r.get('independent_survey_candidates',[])))
 for p in r.get('manufacturing_paragraphs',[]):print(p['paragraph_index'],p['text'])
